findings.reason: four of the five clauses of the check cannot be produced from live session rows, so the node must either fabricate transcripts (which the plan does not authorise and which are not "a session row") or silently narrow the check, and a check a node narrows to fit is the failure the earlier broadening was meant to prevent.
findings.text: the done-when requires that "for every model the base revision's window table serves, a session row on that model reports the same `window_tokens` and a numeric `fraction` at base and at head", but a session row is built only from a real session's transcript (`directory._session_transcripts` → `_context_use`), and over the reckon ledger the view builds 15 rows, every one on `claude-opus-5-5`; measured at e478dac1bd: `ledger.run_rows_from_documents('reckon')` yields 41 sessions, 15 resolve a transcript, and all 15 report `('claude-opus-5-5', 1000000, 'measured')`, so no row exists on the table's other four prefixes (`claude-fable-5`, `claude-sonnet-5`, `claude-haiku-5`, `claude-haiku-4`) to report at base or at head — and the deliverable two sentences earlier narrows this further, to "a Claude 5 model", which excludes the `claude-haiku-4` row the done-when includes

findings.reason: the node is forced to choose between reading only the catalogue (which regresses the packaged case silently, with no test covering it) and keeping an in-source fallback (which leaves the identifiers in place and keeps the routing-identifier test red), and one added sentence naming the resolved behaviour removes the choice.
findings.text: the mechanism moves the window figures to `docs/state/reckon/model-catalogue.yaml`, which `reckon/flight.py::model_catalogue_path` documents as "not shipped in the wheel" and which a wheel install therefore does not carry ("a wheel install, which carries no `docs/`, resolves as it did before the catalogue existed"), so a `_context_window` that reads only the catalogue returns `None` wherever the catalogue is absent and every session row reads `unmeasured`; the section's own deliverable requires that "no row's context window becomes unmeasured", and the plan never says whether that guarantee is scoped to a checkout or what the fallback is outside one

findings.reason: the deliverable already requires the test to pass and the guard's own failure output names lines 45 and 47, so the node cannot close the node without moving them; it is worth one sentence on preserving the provenance, but the gate itself will not let the work land wrong.
findings.text: the section locates the leak at "model identifiers at `reckon/crew/directory.py:45-54`", but the guard reports six offenders and two of them are the explanatory comment at :45 ("The Claude 5 family's window is 1,000,000 tokens") and :47 ("…967,427 tokens, on claude-opus-5-5"), so the register of the figure and its provenance must also leave source; the plan says nothing about where that justification goes, and the guard's pattern (`(sonnet|opus|haiku)` and `claude[-_ ]?[0-9]`, tests/test_skill_contracts.py:28-32) forbids it remaining in `reckon/`
